selection.rationale: The reported baseline maximum arrival is 1.73 ns in request_path. With independently mapped fixed blocks, rewrite_mux leaves those critical paths unchanged and therefore cannot improve the whole-design maximum. rewrite_priority directly targets them, replacing encode-then-decode onehot generation with grouped winner logic. It preserves highest-index priority and the zero-request outputs (valid=0, index=0, onehot=1), while leaving all mux behavior unchanged. This is the only action with a structural opportunity to improve the objective; its mapped timing and compliance with the 2719.608320 um^2 area cap cannot be confirmed from the supplied baseline reports alone.
